policy: No environment variable, boolean or PR workflow may activate cutover. A separately reviewed main-branch migration must verify evidence and implement activation. Historical journals, releases, tags and signatures remain immutable. Legacy coordinator identity v1 is retired for future builds; no positive v1-to-v2 alias migration is required. Historical v1 journals/releases remain immutable and must not be replayed. This does not retire patchsets/v1 source patches used for older upstream compatibility.
